intent: CF-V0-008 closes a hunk whose disposition is a MECHANICALLY REVERIFIED whitespace-only or line-ending-only. The EMPTY document is a canonical codec/refusal case; the V0 entry point rejects its zero-obligation universe.

cases.note: One hunk, disposition whitespace-only, no obligations.
assertions: CF-V0-008: no HUNK_BASIS item is emitted for a reverified whitespace-only hunk.
CF-V0-004: EMPTY requires exact items: [] and exit 0.
CF-V0-018: V0 can be EMPTY only when the intent scope has no linked obligation and all hunks close.
CF-V0-008: no HUNK_BASIS item is emitted.

cases.note: The negative control: CF-V0-008 says a CEM `supported` disposition ALONE never closes. The hunk carries one non-qualifying basis, which is what the expected reason requires: CF-V0-010 derives the remaining hunk reasons as "the unique union across every rejected or term-bound-abstained basis", so INSUFFICIENT_LEXICAL_SUPPORT cannot exist unless a rejected basis edge produced it. The case used to declare no basis at all and an empty relatedIds; both were wrong for the same reason. Once the rejecting edge exists, CF-V0-010's membership sentence — "its `relatedIds` are exactly the sorted unique evidence IDs whose LRF edge contributes a retained reason" — puts that edge's evidence ID in relatedIds.
assertions: CF-V0-008: a supported disposition with no qualifying LRF basis leaves the hunk OPEN.
CF-V0-010: the item is PRODUCER_DECLARED / ACTIONABLE / NARROW_OR_REPLACE_BASIS.

CF-V0-010: relatedIds hold exactly the evidence of the rejected basis that contributed INSUFFICIENT_LEXICAL_SUPPORT; a basis-derived reason with no evidence ID would contradict the union that produced it.
